_comment: Rolls TEDUH's raw block names up into the groupings Samantha reports by.
Keyed by the project's first code, the same key used in data/teduh_history.csv.
groups : raw block name from the unit number -> the name to report it under
label  : word placed before the name. Defaults to 'Block '. Use "" when the
group name already reads as a whole label, e.g. 'Phase 1'.
Any block not listed is reported unchanged, so a new block appearing on TEDUH
shows up under its own name rather than being silently folded into another.
per_code : report one figure per phase CODE instead of parsing unit
numbers at all -- for projects whose numbers invent blocks
(Ferringhi's landed lots). Maps code -> display name.
